684//====================================================================================================================================
685// Functions Definition Section
686//====================================================================================================================================
687// General Mathematical Functions
689static float positive_non_zero(float input)
690{
691 if (input < FLT_EPSILON)
692 {
693 input = 0.00001;
694 }
695 return input;
696}
698void err_nd(float err[], float a[], float b[], float k[], int n)
699{
700 int8_t i;
701 for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
702 err[i] = k[i] * (a[i] - b[i]);
703 }
704}
706void err_sum_nd(float err[], float a[], float b[], float k[], float c[], int n)
707{
708 int8_t i;
709 for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
710 err[i] = k[i] * (a[i] - b[i]);
711 err[i] += c[i];
712 }
713}
715void float_vect_diff_euler(float err[3], float a[3], float b[3])
716{
717 err[0] = (a[0] - b[0]);
718 err[1] = (a[1] - b[1]);
719 err[2] = (a[2] - b[2]);
720 NormRadAngle(err[2]);
721}
723void integrate_nd(float dt, float a[], float a_dot[], int n)
724{
725 int8_t i;
726 for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
727 a[i] = a[i] + dt * a_dot[i];
728 }
729}
731void vect_bound_nd(float vect[], float bound, int n) {
732 float norm = float_vect_norm(vect,n);
733 norm = positive_non_zero(norm);
734 if((norm-bound) > FLT_EPSILON) {
735 float scale = bound/norm;
736 int8_t i;
737 for(i = 0; i < n; i++) {
738 vect[i] *= scale;
739 }
740 }
741}
742//====================================================================================================================================
743// Reference Model Gain Design Functions
745static float k_rm_1_3_f(float omega_n, float zeta, float p1) {
746 omega_n = positive_non_zero(omega_n);
747 zeta = positive_non_zero(zeta);
748 p1 = positive_non_zero(p1);
749 return (omega_n * omega_n * p1) / (omega_n * omega_n + omega_n * p1 * zeta * 2.0);
750}
751static float k_rm_2_3_f(float omega_n, float zeta, float p1) {
752 omega_n = positive_non_zero(omega_n);
753 zeta = positive_non_zero(zeta);
754 p1 = positive_non_zero(p1);
755 return (omega_n * omega_n + omega_n * p1 * zeta * 2.0) / (p1 + omega_n * zeta * 2.0);
756}
757static float k_rm_3_3_f(float omega_n, float zeta, float p1) {
758 omega_n = positive_non_zero(omega_n);
759 zeta = positive_non_zero(zeta);
760 p1 = positive_non_zero(p1);
761 return p1 + omega_n * zeta * 2.0;
762}

764// 3-axis position PID controller
765
766static void Pos_PID(float x_des[3], float x[3],float x_dot[3], float k_P, float k_I, float k_D,float a[3])
767{
768 static float prev_pos[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
769 static float integral[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
770 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
771 {
772 float err = x_des[i] - x[i];
773 integral[i] += err * dt_1l;
774 // Optional anti-windup
775 const float I_MAX = 0.4f;
776 if (integral[i] > I_MAX) integral[i] = I_MAX;
777 if (integral[i] < -I_MAX) integral[i] = -I_MAX;
778#ifdef USE_PID_NUMDIFF_DERIVATIVE
779 // Numerical derivative
780 //static float prev_err[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
781 //float derivative = (err - prev_err[i]) / dt_1l;
782 //prev_err[i] = err;
783 float derivative_nd = (x[i] - prev_pos[i]) / dt_1l;
784 prev_pos[i] = x[i];
785 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&filt_veloc[i], derivative_nd);
786 float derivative = -filt_veloc[i].o[0];
787#else
788 float derivative = -x_dot[i];
789#endif
790
791 // Temp debug
792 temp_P_error[i] = k_P * err;
793 temp_D_error[i] = k_D * derivative;
794 temp_I_error[i] = k_I * integral[i];
795 a[i] = k_P * err+ k_I * integral[i]+ k_D * derivative;
796 }
797 vect_bound_nd(a,0.5*9.81,3);
798}
799static void shape_vector(float a[3]){
800 a[2] += -9.81;
801 vect_bound_nd(a,1.0,3);
802}
803static void eul_of_acc(float a[3], float psi){
804 float phi_des;
805 float theta_des;
806
807 float spsi = sinf(psi);
808 float cpsi = cosf(psi);
809 //printf("psi:%f \n",DegOfRad(psi));
810 float aX = cpsi*a[0]+spsi*a[1];
811 float aY =-spsi*a[0]+cpsi*a[1];
812 //printf("[aX,aY]=[%f,%f] \n",aX,aY);
813 theta_des = asinf(-aX);
814 float ctheta_des = cosf(theta_des);
815 if (fabs(ctheta_des) < FLT_EPSILON){ctheta_des = FLT_EPSILON;}
816 phi_des = asinf(aY/ctheta_des);
817 //printf("[phi_des,theta_des]=[%f,%f] \n",DegOfRad(phi_des),DegOfRad(theta_des));
818 BoundAbs(phi_des, M_PI_6); // Limit to 30 deg
819 BoundAbs(theta_des, M_PI_6); // Limit to 30 deg
820 eulers_zxy_des.phi = phi_des;
821 eulers_zxy_des.theta = theta_des;
822}

826// void float_rates_of_euler_dot_vec(float r[3], float e[3], float edot[3])
827// {
828// float sphi = sinf(e[0]);
829// float cphi = cosf(e[0]);
830// float stheta = sinf(e[1]);
831// float ctheta = cosf(e[1]);
832// r[0] = edot[0] - stheta * edot[2];
833// r[1] = cphi * edot[1] + sphi * ctheta * edot[2];
834// r[2] = -sphi * edot[1] + cphi * ctheta * edot[2];
835// }
836
838void float_rates_of_euler_dot_vec(float r[3], float e[3], float edot[3])
839{
840 float sphi = sinf(e[0]);
841 float cphi = cosf(e[0]);
842 float stheta = sinf(e[1]);
843 float ctheta = cosf(e[1]);
844 r[0] = ctheta * edot[0] - stheta * cphi * edot[2];
845 r[1] = edot[1] + sphi * edot[2];
846 r[2] = stheta * edot[0] + ctheta *cphi * edot[2];
847}
848
850// void float_euler_dot_of_rates_vec(float r[3], float e[3], float edot[3])
851// {
852// float sphi = sinf(e[0]);
853// float cphi = cosf(e[0]);
854// float stheta = sinf(e[1]);
855// float ctheta = cosf(e[1]);
856// if (fabs(ctheta) < FLT_EPSILON)
857// {
858// ctheta = FLT_EPSILON;
859// }
860// edot[0] = r[0] + sphi * stheta / ctheta * r[1] + cphi * stheta / ctheta * r[2];
861// edot[1] = cphi * r[1] - sphi * r[2];
862// edot[2] = sphi / ctheta * r[1] + cphi / ctheta * r[2];
863// }
864
866void float_euler_dot_of_rates_vec(float r[3], float e[3], float edot[3])
867{
868 float sphi = sinf(e[0]);
869 float cphi = cosf(e[0]);
870 float stheta = sinf(e[1]);
871 float ctheta = cosf(e[1]);
872 float spsi = sinf(e[2]);
873 float cpsi = cosf(e[2]);
874
875 if (fabs(ctheta) < FLT_EPSILON)
876 {
877 ctheta = FLT_EPSILON;
878 }
879 edot[0] = r[0] + spsi * stheta / ctheta * r[1] + cpsi * stheta / ctheta * r[2];
880 edot[1] = cphi * r[1] - sphi * r[2];
881 edot[2] = sphi * r[1] + cphi * r[2];
882}
883//====================================================================================================================================
884// Bounding Functions
886void acc_body_bound(struct FloatVect2 *vect, float bound)
887{
888 int n = 2;
889 float v[2] = {vect->x, vect->y};
890 float sign_v0 = (v[0] > 0.f) ? 1.f : (v[0] < 0.f) ? -1.f : 0.f;
891 float sign_v1 = (v[1] > 0.f) ? 1.f : (v[1] < 0.f) ? -1.f : 0.f;
892 float norm = float_vect_norm(v, n);
893 v[0] = fabsf(v[0]);
894 v[1] = fabsf(v[1]);
895 norm = positive_non_zero(norm);
896 if ((norm - bound) > FLT_EPSILON)
897 {
898 v[0] = Min(v[0], bound);
899 float acc_b_y_2 = bound * bound - v[0] * v[0];
900 acc_b_y_2 = positive_non_zero(acc_b_y_2);
901 v[1] = sqrtf(acc_b_y_2);
902 }
903 vect->x = sign_v0 * v[0];
904 vect->y = sign_v1 * v[1];
905}
915float bound_v_from_a_vect(float e_x[], float v_bound, float a_bound, int n)
916{
917 float norm = float_vect_norm(e_x, n);
918 norm = fmaxf(norm, 1.0);
919 float v_bound_a = sqrtf(fabs(2.0 * a_bound * norm * xdot_lim_sf));
920 return fminf(v_bound, v_bound_a);
921}
931float bound_v_from_a(float e_x, float v_bound, float a_bound)
932{
933 float norm;
934 norm = fabsf(e_x);
935 //norm = fmaxf(norm, 1.0);
936 float v_bound_a = sqrtf(fabs(2.0 * a_bound * norm * xdot_lim_sf));
937 return fminf(v_bound, v_bound_a);
938}
939//====================================================================================================================================
940// Reference Model Functions
956void rm_3rd_attitude(float dt, float x_ref[3], float x_d_ref[3], float x_2d_ref[3], float x_3d_ref[3], float x_des[3], bool ow_psi, float psi_overwrite[4], float k1_rm[3], float k2_rm[3], float k3_rm[3], struct OneloopStabilizationRef bounds){
957
958 float e_x[3]; // Attitude Error
959 float x_d_fw[3]; // Forward Signal Euler Dot
960 float x_d_fw_rates[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Rates
961 float x_2d_fw[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Acceleration
962 float x_3d_fw[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Jerk
963 float bounds_att_d[3]; // Bounds on Angular Rate (SUVAT based)
964 float x_d_eul_ref[3]; // Euler angle Reference
965 // Attitude error --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
966 float_vect_diff_euler(e_x, x_des, x_ref); // Calculate Attitude Error
967 x_d_fw[0] = e_x[0] * k1_rm[0]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
968 x_d_fw[1] = e_x[1] * k1_rm[1]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
969 x_d_fw[2] = e_x[2] * k1_rm[2]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
970 float_rates_of_euler_dot_vec(x_d_fw_rates, x_ref, x_d_fw); // Convert Euler Dot to Angular Rates
971 bounds_att_d[0] = bound_v_from_a(e_x[0], bounds.att_d[0], bounds.att_2d[0]);
972 bounds_att_d[1] = bound_v_from_a(e_x[1], bounds.att_d[1], bounds.att_2d[1]);
973 bounds_att_d[2] = bound_v_from_a(e_x[2], bounds.att_d[2], bounds.att_2d[2]);
974 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates[0], bounds_att_d[0]);
975 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates[1], bounds_att_d[1]);
976 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates[2], bounds_att_d[2]);
977 // Angular Rate error ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
978 err_nd(x_2d_fw, x_d_fw_rates, x_d_ref, k2_rm, 3);
979 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[0], bounds.att_2d[0]);
980 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[1], bounds.att_2d[1]);
981 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[2], bounds.att_2d[2]);
982 // Angular Acceleration error -----------------------------------------
983 err_nd(x_3d_fw, x_2d_fw, x_2d_ref, k3_rm, 3);
984 BoundAbs(x_3d_fw[0], bounds.att_3d[0]);
985 BoundAbs(x_3d_fw[1], bounds.att_3d[1]);
986 BoundAbs(x_3d_fw[2], bounds.att_3d[2]);
987 // Angular Jerk Reference ---------------------------------------------
988 float_vect_copy(x_3d_ref, x_3d_fw, 3);
989 if (ow_psi){x_3d_ref[2] = psi_overwrite[3];}
990 // Angular Acceleration Reference -------------------------------------
991 integrate_nd(dt, x_2d_ref, x_3d_ref, 3);
992 if (ow_psi){x_2d_ref[2] = psi_overwrite[2];}
993 // Angular Rate Reference ---------------------------------------------
994 integrate_nd(dt, x_d_ref, x_2d_ref, 3);
995 if (ow_psi){x_d_ref[2] = psi_overwrite[1];}
996 // Attitude Reference ------------------------------------------------
997 float_euler_dot_of_rates_vec(x_d_ref, x_ref, x_d_eul_ref);
998 integrate_nd(dt, x_ref, x_d_eul_ref, 3);
999 if (ow_psi){x_ref[2] = psi_overwrite[0];}
1000 NormRadAngle(x_ref[2]);
1001}
1002
1003
1020void rm_3rd_pos(float dt, float x_ref[], float x_d_ref[], float x_2d_ref[], float x_3d_ref[], float x_des[], float k1_rm[], float k2_rm[], float k3_rm[], float x_d_bound, float x_2d_bound, float x_3d_bound, int n)
1021{
1022 float e_x[n];
1023 float e_x_d[n];
1024 float e_x_2d[n];
1025 err_nd(e_x, x_des, x_ref, k1_rm, n);
1026 float max_x_d = bound_v_from_a_vect(e_x, x_d_bound, x_2d_bound, n);
1027 vect_bound_nd(e_x, max_x_d, n);
1028 err_nd(e_x_d, e_x, x_d_ref, k2_rm, n);
1029 vect_bound_nd(e_x_d, x_2d_bound, n);
1030 err_nd(e_x_2d, e_x_d, x_2d_ref, k3_rm, n);
1031 float_vect_copy(x_3d_ref, e_x_2d, n);
1032 vect_bound_nd(x_3d_ref, x_3d_bound, n);
1033 integrate_nd(dt, x_2d_ref, x_3d_ref, n);
1034 integrate_nd(dt, x_d_ref, x_2d_ref, n);
1035 integrate_nd(dt, x_ref, x_d_ref, n);
1036}

1051void rm_2nd_pos(float dt, float x_d_ref[], float x_2d_ref[], float x_3d_ref[], float x_d_des[], float k2_rm[], float k3_rm[], float x_2d_bound, float x_3d_bound, int n)
1052{
1053 float e_x_d[n];
1054 float e_x_2d[n];
1055 err_nd(e_x_d, x_d_des, x_d_ref, k2_rm, n);
1056 vect_bound_nd(e_x_d, x_2d_bound, n);
1057 err_nd(e_x_2d, e_x_d, x_2d_ref, k3_rm, n);
1058 float_vect_copy(x_3d_ref, e_x_2d, n);
1059 vect_bound_nd(x_3d_ref, x_3d_bound, n);
1060 integrate_nd(dt, x_2d_ref, x_3d_ref, n);
1061 integrate_nd(dt, x_d_ref, x_2d_ref, n);
1062}

1074void rm_1st_pos(float dt, float x_2d_ref[], float x_3d_ref[], float x_2d_des[], float k3_rm[], float x_3d_bound, int n)
1075{
1076 float e_x_2d[n];

1083// Error Controller Functions
1099void ec_3rd_pos(float y_4d[], float x_des[], float x_ref[], float x_d_ref[], float x_2d_ref[], float x_3d_ref[], float x[], float x_d[], float x_2d[], float k1_e[], float k2_e[], float k3_e[], float x_d_bound, float x_2d_bound, float fb[], int n)
1100{
1101 float e_x_d[n];
1102 float e_x_2d[n];
1103 float e_x_des[n];
1104 float_vect_diff(e_x_des, x_des, x, n);
1105 float max_x_d = bound_v_from_a_vect(e_x_des, x_d_bound * ec_headroom, x_2d_bound * ec_headroom, n);
1106 err_sum_nd(e_x_d, x_ref, x, k1_e, x_d_ref, n);
1107 vect_bound_nd(e_x_d, max_x_d, n);
1108 err_sum_nd(e_x_2d, e_x_d, x_d, k2_e, x_2d_ref, n);
1109 vect_bound_nd(e_x_2d, x_2d_bound * ec_headroom, n);
1110 // Calculate and bound distrubance --------------------
1111 float dist[3];
1112 float_vect_diff(dist, x_2d, fb, 3);
1113 err_sum_nd(y_4d, e_x_2d, dist, k3_e, x_3d_ref, n);
1114}
1115
1131void ec_3rd_att(float y_4d[3], float x_des[3], float x_ref[3], float x_d_ref[3], float x_2d_ref[3], float x_3d_ref[3], float x[3], float x_d[3], float x_2d[3], float k1_e[3], float k2_e[3], float k3_e[3], struct OneloopStabilizationRef bounds, float fb[3])
1132{
1133 float e_x[3]; // Attitude Error on Reference
1134 float e_x_des[3]; // Attitude Error on Desired
1135 float x_d_fw[3]; // Forward Signal Euler Dot
1136 float x_d_fw_rates[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Rates
1137 float x_d_fw_rates_rm[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Rates plus RM
1138 float x_2d_fw[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Acceleration
1139 float bounds_att_d[3];
1140 // Attitude Error and Heading conversion --------------------------------
1141 float_vect_diff_euler(e_x,x_ref,x); // Calculate the Attitude Error
1142 x_d_fw[0] = e_x[0]*k1_e[0]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
1143 x_d_fw[1] = e_x[1]*k1_e[1]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
1144 x_d_fw[2] = e_x[2]*k1_e[2]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
1145 float_rates_of_euler_dot_vec(x_d_fw_rates, x, x_d_fw); // Euler dot to rates conversion
1146 float_vect_sum(x_d_fw_rates_rm, x_d_ref, x_d_fw_rates, 3);// Add body rates reference signal
1147 float_vect_diff_euler(e_x_des, x_des, x);
1148 bounds_att_d[0] = bound_v_from_a(e_x_des[0], bounds.att_d[0] * ec_headroom, bounds.att_2d[0] * ec_headroom);
1149 bounds_att_d[1] = bound_v_from_a(e_x_des[1], bounds.att_d[1] * ec_headroom, bounds.att_2d[1] * ec_headroom);
1150 bounds_att_d[2] = bound_v_from_a(e_x_des[2], bounds.att_d[2] * ec_headroom, bounds.att_2d[2] * ec_headroom);
1151 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates_rm[0], bounds_att_d[0]);
1152 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates_rm[1], bounds_att_d[1]);
1153 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates_rm[2], bounds_att_d[2]);
1154 // Angular Rate Error ---------------------------------------------------
1155 x_2d_fw[0] = (x_d_fw_rates_rm[0] - x_d[0]) * k2_e[0] + x_2d_ref[0];
1156 x_2d_fw[1] = (x_d_fw_rates_rm[1] - x_d[1]) * k2_e[1] + x_2d_ref[1];
1157 x_2d_fw[2] = (x_d_fw_rates_rm[2] - x_d[2]) * k2_e[2] + x_2d_ref[2];
1158 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[0], bounds.att_2d[0] * ec_headroom);
1159 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[1], bounds.att_2d[1] * ec_headroom);
1160 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[2], bounds.att_2d[2] * ec_headroom);
1161 // Calculate and bound distrubance --------------------------------------
1162 float dist[3];
1163 float_vect_diff(dist, x_2d, fb, 3); // The Disturbance is THe difference between the measurment and the Model
1164 //BoundAbs(dist[2], oneloop_andi_yaw_dist_limit); //FIXME UNCOMMENT ME TO HAVE MAX YAW CONTROL EFFORT
1165 // Angular Acceleration Error -------------------------------------------
1166 err_sum_nd(y_4d, x_2d_fw, dist, k3_e, x_3d_ref, 3);
1167}
1168
1176static float w_approx(float p1, float p2, float p3, float rm_k)
1177{
1178 p1 = positive_non_zero(p1);
1179 p2 = positive_non_zero(p2);
1180 p3 = positive_non_zero(p3);
1181 rm_k = positive_non_zero(rm_k);
1182 float tao = (p1 * p2 + p1 * p3 + p2 * p3) / (p1 * p2 * p3) / (rm_k);
1183 tao = positive_non_zero(tao);
1184 return 1.0 / tao;
1185}

1192{

1194 // Attitude Controller Poles----------------------------------------------------------

1196

1198 p_att_e.zeta = 1.0;
1199 p_att_e.p3 = p_att_e.omega_n;

1388static inline void init_filter_on_type(struct LP_t *filter, float x0)
1389{
1390 switch (filter->filter_type)
1391 {
1392 case LOWPASS_1:
1393 init_first_order_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.lp1, filter->tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, x0);
1394 break;
1395 case BUTTERWORTH_2:
1396 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.bw2, filter->tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, x0);
1397 break;
1398 case BUTTERWORTH_4:
1399 init_butterworth_4_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.bw4, filter->tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, x0);
1400 break;
1401 case NOTCH:
1402 notch_filter_init(&filter->meas_filt.notch, filter->freq, filter->bandwidth, PERIODIC_FREQUENCY);
1403 break;
1404 default:
1405 // Handle unexpected filter type
1406 break;
1407 }
1408}
1410static inline void update_filter_on_type(struct LP_t *filter, float input)
1411{
1412 // filter->meas_prev = filter->meas;
1413 // filter->meas = input;
1414 switch (filter->filter_type)
1415 {
1416 case LOWPASS_1:
1417 update_first_order_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.lp1, input);
1418 filter->out = filter->meas_filt.lp1.last_out;
1419 break;
1420 case BUTTERWORTH_2:
1421 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.bw2, input);
1422 filter->out = filter->meas_filt.bw2.o[0];
1423 break;
1424 case BUTTERWORTH_4:
1425 update_butterworth_4_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.bw4, input);
1426 filter->out = filter->meas_filt.bw4.lp2.o[0];
1427 break;
1428 case NOTCH:
1429 {
1430 notch_filter_update(&filter->meas_filt.notch, &input, &filter->out);
1431 break;
1432 }
1433 default:
1434 filter->out = 0.0;
1435 break;
1436 // Handle unexpected filter type
1437 }
1438}
1440static inline void init_LP(struct LP_t *LP, float fc)
1441{
1442 LP->freq = fc;
1443 LP->freq_set = fc;
1444 LP->tau = 1 / (2 * M_PI * LP->freq);
1445#ifdef USE_LP1
1446 LP->filter_type = LOWPASS_1;
1447#elif defined(USE_BW2)
1448 LP->filter_type = BUTTERWORTH_2;
1449#elif defined(USE_YAW_LP4)
1450 LP->filter_type = BUTTERWORTH_4;
1451#endif
1452 init_filter_on_type(LP, 0.0);
1453 // init_first_order_low_pass(&LP->meas_filt, LP->tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, 0.0);
1454 LP->meas = 0.0;
1455 LP->meas_prev = 0.0;
1456 LP->out = 0.0;
1457}
1459static inline void reinit_LP_synchronous(struct LP_t *LP, struct LP_t *f, bool reinit)
1460{
1461 if (LP->freq != LP->freq_set || reinit)
1462 {
1463 LP->freq = LP->freq_set;
1464 LP->tau = 1 / (2 * M_PI * LP->freq);
1465 init_filter_on_type(LP, LP->out);
1466 init_filter_on_type(f, f->out);
1467 }
1468}
1469static inline void reinit_LP(struct LP_t *LP, bool reinit)
1470{
1471 if (LP->freq != LP->freq_set || reinit)
1472 {
1473 LP->freq = LP->freq_set;
1474 LP->tau = 1 / (2 * M_PI * LP->freq);
1475 init_filter_on_type(LP, LP->out);
1476 }
1477}
1478

1481{
1482 init_LP(&LP.ax, 2.0); // oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff_a
1483 init_LP(&LP.ay, 2.0); // oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff_a
1484 init_LP(&LP.az, 2.0); // oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff_a

1486 init_LP(&LP.q_dot, 2.0);
1487 init_LP(&LP.r_dot, 2.0);
1488 init_LP(&LP.p, 15.0); // oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff_p
1489 init_LP(&LP.q, 15.0); // oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff_q
1490 init_LP(&LP.r, 15.0); // oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff_r
1491
1492 init_LP(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.ax, 2.0); // oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff_a
1493 init_LP(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.ay, 2.0); // oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff_a
1494 init_LP(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.az, 2.0); // oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff_a
1495 init_LP(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.p_dot, 2.0);
1496 init_LP(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.q_dot, 2.0);
1497 init_LP(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.r_dot, 2.0);
1498}

1501static inline void reinit_all_LP(bool reinit)
1502{
1503 reinit_LP_synchronous(&LP.ax, &oneloop_andi_model_filt.ax, reinit);
1504 reinit_LP_synchronous(&LP.ay, &oneloop_andi_model_filt.ay, reinit);

1506 reinit_LP_synchronous(&LP.p_dot, &oneloop_andi_model_filt.p_dot, reinit);
1507 reinit_LP_synchronous(&LP.q_dot, &oneloop_andi_model_filt.q_dot, reinit);
1508 reinit_LP_synchronous(&LP.r_dot, &oneloop_andi_model_filt.r_dot, reinit);

1516void init_filter(void)
1517{
1518 // Filtering of the velocities
1519 float tau = 1.0 / (2.0 * M_PI * oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff);
1520 float tau_v = 1.0 / (2.0 * M_PI * oneloop_andi_filt_cutoff_v);
1521 float tau_2 = 1.0 / (2.0 * M_PI * 2.0);
1522 // printf("tau: %f tau_v: %f\n", tau, tau_v);
1523 // printf("initializing filters\n");
1524 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&accely_filt, tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, accely_filt.o[0]);
1525 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&airspeed_filt, tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, airspeed_filt.o[0]);
1526#ifdef USE_PID_NUMDIFF_DERIVATIVE
1527 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++){
1528 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&filt_veloc[i], tau_v, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, filt_veloc[i].o[0]);
1529 }
1530#endif
1531 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
1532 {
1533 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&u_filt[i], tau_2, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, 0.0);
1534 }
1535}
1536
1538void oneloop_andi_propagate_filters(void)
1539{
1540 reinit_all_LP(false);
1541 struct NedCoor_f *veloc = stateGetSpeedNed_f();
1542 struct FloatRates *body_rates = stateGetBodyRates_f();
1543#ifdef USE_ND_VELOCITIES
1544 static bool vel_inited = false;
1545 static struct NedCoor_f veloc_prev;
1546 if (!vel_inited) { veloc_prev = *veloc; vel_inited = true; }
1547 LP.ax.meas = (veloc->x - veloc_prev.x) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
1548 LP.ay.meas = (veloc->y - veloc_prev.y) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
1549 LP.az.meas = (veloc->z - veloc_prev.z) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
1550 veloc_prev = *veloc;
1551#else
1552 struct NedCoor_f *accel = stateGetAccelNed_f();
1553 LP.ax.meas = accel->x;
1554 LP.ay.meas = accel->y;
1555 LP.az.meas = accel->z;
1556#endif
1557 LP.p.meas_prev = LP.p.meas;
1558 LP.q.meas_prev = LP.q.meas;
1559 LP.r.meas_prev = LP.r.meas;
1560 LP.p.meas = body_rates->p;
1561 LP.q.meas = body_rates->q;
1562 LP.r.meas = body_rates->r;
1563 LP.p_dot.meas = (LP.p.meas - LP.p.meas_prev) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
1564 LP.q_dot.meas = (LP.q.meas - LP.q.meas_prev) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
1565 LP.r_dot.meas = (LP.r.meas - LP.r.meas_prev) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
1566 // Update Filters of Feedbacks
1567 update_filter_on_type(&LP.ax, LP.ax.meas);
1568 update_filter_on_type(&LP.ay, LP.ay.meas);
1569 update_filter_on_type(&LP.az, LP.az.meas);
1570 update_filter_on_type(&LP.p_dot, LP.p_dot.meas);
1571 update_filter_on_type(&LP.q_dot, LP.q_dot.meas);
1572 update_filter_on_type(&LP.r_dot, LP.r_dot.meas);
1573 update_filter_on_type(&LP.p, LP.p.meas);
1574 update_filter_on_type(&LP.q, LP.q.meas);
1575 update_filter_on_type(&LP.r, LP.r.meas);
1576 // Propagate filter for sideslip correction
1577 float accely = ACCEL_FLOAT_OF_BFP(stateGetAccelBody_i()->y);
1578 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&accely_filt, accely);
1579 float airspeed_meas = stateGetAirspeed_f();
1580 Bound(airspeed_meas, 0.0, 30.0);
1581 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&airspeed_filt, airspeed_meas);
1582}

1640 bwls_1l[i] = EFF_MAT_G[i];

1668 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_DEBUG_VECT, send_oneloop_debug);
1669 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_WLS_V, send_wls_v_oneloop);
1670 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_WLS_U, send_wls_u_oneloop);
1671#endif

1724void oneloop_andi_RM(bool half_loop, struct FloatVect3 PSA_des, int rm_order_h, int rm_order_v, bool in_flight_oneloop)
1725{
1726 // Initialize some variables
1727 a_thrust = 0.0;
1728 nav_target[0] = PSA_des.x;
1729 nav_target[1] = PSA_des.y;
1730 nav_target[2] = PSA_des.z;
1731 float thrust_cmd_1l = 0.0;
1732 float des_r = 0.0;
1733 // Generate reference signals with reference model
1734 if (half_loop)
1735 {
1736 // Disregard X and Y jerk objectives
1737 WLS_one_p.Wv[0] = 0.0;
1738 WLS_one_p.Wv[1] = 0.0;
1739 if (drop_yaw)
1740 {
1741 WLS_one_p.Wv[5] = 0.0;
1742 }
1743 else
1744 {
1745 WLS_one_p.Wv[5] = Wv_backup[5];
1746 }
1747 // Overwrite references with actual signals (for consistent plotting)
1748 float_vect_copy(oneloop_andi.gui_ref.pos, oneloop_andi.gui_state.pos, 3);
1749 float_vect_copy(oneloop_andi.gui_ref.vel, oneloop_andi.gui_state.vel, 3);
1750 float_vect_copy(oneloop_andi.gui_ref.acc, oneloop_andi.gui_state.acc, 3);
1751 float_vect_zero(oneloop_andi.gui_ref.jer, 3);
1752 // Set desired attitude with stick input
1753 eulers_zxy_des.phi = (float)(radio_control_get(RADIO_ROLL)) / MAX_PPRZ * ONELOOP_ANDI_MAX_PHI;
1754 eulers_zxy_des.theta = (float)(radio_control_get(RADIO_PITCH)) / MAX_PPRZ * ONELOOP_ANDI_MAX_THETA;
1755 // Set desired Yaw rate with stick input
1756 des_r = (float)(radio_control_get(RADIO_YAW)) / MAX_PPRZ * max_r; // Get yaw rate from stick
1757 BoundAbs(des_r, max_r); // Bound yaw rate
1758 float delta_psi_des_rad = des_r * dt_1l; // Integrate desired Yaw rate to get desired change in yaw
1759 float delta_psi_rad = eulers_zxy_des.psi - eulers_zxy.psi; // Calculate current yaw difference between des and actual
1760 NormRadAngle(delta_psi_rad); // Normalize the difference
1761 if (fabs(delta_psi_rad) > RadOfDeg(30.0))
1762 { // If difference is bigger than 10 deg do not further increment desired
1763 delta_psi_des_rad = 0.0;
1764 }
1765 psi_des_rad += delta_psi_des_rad; // Incrementdesired yaw
1766 NormRadAngle(psi_des_rad);
1767 // Register Attitude Setpoints from previous loop
1768 if (!in_flight_oneloop)
1769 {
1770 psi_des_rad = eulers_zxy.psi;
1771 }
1772 eulers_zxy_des.psi = psi_des_rad;
1773 float att_des[3] = {eulers_zxy_des.phi, eulers_zxy_des.theta, eulers_zxy_des.psi};
1774 // Create commands adhoc to get actuators to the wanted level
1775 thrust_cmd_1l = (float)radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE);
1776 Bound(thrust_cmd_1l, 0.0, MAX_PPRZ);
1777 int8_t i;
1778 // To calculate the nu corrsponding to the Thrust command, plug it in the control law.
1779 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT; i++)
1780 {
1781 if (oneloop_andi.ctrl_type == CTRL_ANDI)
1782 {
1783 a_thrust += (thrust_cmd_1l)*EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aD][i] * act_dyn_ctrl[i];
1784 }
1785 else
1786 {
1787 a_thrust += (thrust_cmd_1l)*EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aD][i];
1788 }
1789 }
1790 a_thrust = a_thrust - oneloop_andi_model[RW_aD]; // oneloop_andi_model_filt.az.out;
1791 rm_3rd_attitude(dt_1l, oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att, oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_d, oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d, oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_3d, att_des, false, psi_vec, k_att_rm.k1, k_att_rm.k2, k_att_rm.k3, sta_bounds);
1792 }
1793 else
1794 {
1795 // Make sure X and Y jerk objectives are active
1796 WLS_one_p.Wv[0] = Wv_backup[0];
1797 WLS_one_p.Wv[1] = Wv_backup[1];
1798 // Generate Reference signals for positioning using RM
1799 if (rm_order_h == 3)
1800 {
1801 rm_3rd_pos(dt_1l, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.pos, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.vel, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.acc, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.jer, nav_target, k_pos_rm.k1, k_pos_rm.k2, k_pos_rm.k3, max_v_nav, max_a_nav, max_j_lin, 2);
1802 }
1803 else if (rm_order_h == 2)
1804 {
1805 float_vect_copy(oneloop_andi.gui_ref.pos, oneloop_andi.gui_state.pos, 2);
1806 float_vect_copy(oneloop_andi.gui_ref.vel, oneloop_andi.gui_state.vel, 2);
1807 reshape_wind(); // returns accel sp as nav target new
1808 rm_1st_pos(dt_1l, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.acc, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.jer, nav_target_new, k_pos_rm.k3, max_j_lin, 2);
1809 // rm_2nd_pos(dt_1l, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.vel, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.acc, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.jer, nav_target_new, k_pos_rm.k2, k_pos_rm.k3, max_a_nav, max_j_lin, 2);
1810 }
1811 else if (rm_order_h == 1)
1812 {
1813 float_vect_copy(oneloop_andi.gui_ref.pos, oneloop_andi.gui_state.pos, 2);
1814 float_vect_copy(oneloop_andi.gui_ref.vel, oneloop_andi.gui_state.vel, 2);
1815 rm_1st_pos(dt_1l, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.acc, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.jer, nav_target, k_pos_rm.k3, max_j_lin, 2);
1816 }
1817 // Update desired Heading (psi_des_rad) based on previous loop or changed setting
1818 if (heading_manual)
1819 {
1820 psi_des_rad = RadOfDeg(psi_des_deg);
1821 if (yaw_stick_in_auto)
1822 {
1823 psi_des_rad += (float)(radio_control_get(RADIO_YAW)) / MAX_PPRZ * max_r * dt_1l;
1824 }
1825 }
1826 else
1827 {
1828 psi_des_rad += oneloop_andi_sideslip() * dt_1l;
1829 NormRadAngle(psi_des_rad);
1830 }
1831 // Register Attitude Setpoints from previous loop
1832 if (!in_flight_oneloop)
1833 {
1834 psi_des_rad = eulers_zxy.psi;
1835 }
1836 eulers_zxy_des.psi = psi_des_rad;
1837 float att_des[3] = {eulers_zxy_des.phi, eulers_zxy_des.theta, eulers_zxy_des.psi};
1838 // The RM functions want an array as input. Create a single entry array and write the vertical guidance entries.
1839 float single_value_ref[1] = {oneloop_andi.gui_ref.pos[2]};
1840 float single_value_d_ref[1] = {oneloop_andi.gui_ref.vel[2]};
1841 float single_value_2d_ref[1] = {oneloop_andi.gui_ref.acc[2]};
1842 float single_value_3d_ref[1] = {oneloop_andi.gui_ref.jer[2]};
1843 float single_value_nav_target[1] = {nav_target[2]};
1844 float single_value_k1_rm[1] = {k_pos_rm.k1[2]};
1845 float single_value_k2_rm[1] = {k_pos_rm.k2[2]};
1846 float single_value_k3_rm[1] = {k_pos_rm.k3[2]};
1847 if (rm_order_v == 3)
1848 {
1849 rm_3rd_pos(dt_1l, single_value_ref, single_value_d_ref, single_value_2d_ref, single_value_3d_ref, single_value_nav_target, single_value_k1_rm, single_value_k2_rm, single_value_k3_rm, max_v_nav_v, max_a_nav, max_j_lin, 1);
1850 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.pos[2] = single_value_ref[0];
1851 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.vel[2] = single_value_d_ref[0];
1852 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.acc[2] = single_value_2d_ref[0];
1853 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.jer[2] = single_value_3d_ref[0];
1854 }
1855 else if (rm_order_v == 2)
1856 {
1857 rm_2nd_pos(dt_1l, single_value_d_ref, single_value_2d_ref, single_value_3d_ref, single_value_nav_target, single_value_k2_rm, single_value_k3_rm, max_a_nav, max_j_lin, 1);
1858 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.pos[2] = oneloop_andi.gui_state.pos[2];
1859 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.vel[2] = single_value_d_ref[0];
1860 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.acc[2] = single_value_2d_ref[0];
1861 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.jer[2] = single_value_3d_ref[0];
1862 }
1863 else if (rm_order_v == 1)
1864 {
1865 rm_1st_pos(dt_1l, single_value_2d_ref, single_value_3d_ref, single_value_nav_target, single_value_k3_rm, max_j_lin, 1);
1866 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.pos[2] = oneloop_andi.gui_state.pos[2];
1867 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.vel[2] = oneloop_andi.gui_state.vel[2];
1868 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.acc[2] = single_value_2d_ref[0];
1869 oneloop_andi.gui_ref.jer[2] = single_value_3d_ref[0];
1870 }
1871 // Run chirp test if turnerd on (overwrite the guidance references)
1872 if (chirp_on && !multiple_chirp_run)
1873 {
1874 multiple_chirp_run = true;
1875 chirp_on = false;
1876 }
1877 if (multiple_chirp_run && !chirp_on)
1878 {
1879 if (chirp_n_counter < chirp_n_repeat)
1880 {
1881 delay_counter++;
1882 int16_t idx_acc = 0;
1883 float trigger_acc = 0.0;
1884 switch (chirp_axis)
1885 {
1886 case 5: // Yaw
1887 idx_acc = 2;
1888 trigger_acc = 5.0;
1889 break;
1890 case 6: // Roll
1891 idx_acc = 0;
1892 trigger_acc = 15.0;
1893 break;
1894 }
1895 if (fabsf(oneloop_andi.sta_state.att_2d[idx_acc]) < RadOfDeg(trigger_acc) && delay_counter >= 2500 && fabsf(oneloop_andi.sta_state.att_d[idx_acc]) < RadOfDeg(5.0))
1896 {
1897 firing_counter++;
1898 }
1899 else
1900 {
1901 firing_counter = 0;
1902 }
1903 if (firing_counter >= 250)
1904 {
1905 chirp_n_counter++;
1906 chirp_on = true;
1907 firing_counter = 0;
1908 delay_counter = 0;
1909 }
1910 }
1911 else
1912 {
1913 multiple_chirp_run = false;
1914 chirp_n_counter = 0;
1915 }
1916 }
1917
1918 chirp_call(&chirp_on, &chirp_first_call, &t_0_chirp, &time_elapsed_chirp, f0_chirp, f1_chirp, t_chirp, A_chirp, chirp_axis, att_des[2], oneloop_andi.gui_ref.pos, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.vel, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.acc, oneloop_andi.gui_ref.jer, p_ref_0);
1919 // Generate Reference signals for attitude using RM
1920 // FIX ME ow not yet defined, will be useful in the future to have accurate psi tracking in NAV functions
1921 bool ow_psi = false;
1922 if (chirp_on && (chirp_axis == 4 || chirp_axis == 5))
1923 {
1924 ow_psi = true;
1925 psi_vec[0] = oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att[2];
1926 psi_vec[1] = oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_d[2];
1927 psi_vec[2] = oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d[2];
1928 psi_vec[3] = oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_3d[2];
1929 att_des[0] = 0.0;
1930 att_des[1] = 0.0;
1931 eulers_zxy_des.phi = 0.0;
1932 eulers_zxy_des.theta = 0.0;
1933 }
1934 bool ow_phi = false;
1935 if (chirp_on && chirp_axis == 6)
1936 {
1937 ow_phi = true;
1938 phi_vec[0] = oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att[0];
1939 phi_vec[1] = oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_d[0];
1940 phi_vec[2] = oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d[0];
1941 phi_vec[3] = oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_3d[0];
1942 eulers_zxy_des.theta = 1.7;
1943 }
1944 rm_3rd_attitude(dt_1l, oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att, oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_d, oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d, oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_3d, att_des, ow_psi, psi_vec, k_att_rm.k1, k_att_rm.k2, k_att_rm.k3, sta_bounds);
1945 if (ow_phi)
1946 {
1947 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att[0] = phi_vec[0];
1948 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_d[0] = phi_vec[1];
1949 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d[0] = phi_vec[2];
1950 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_3d[0] = phi_vec[3];
1951 }
1952 }
1953}

2193#ifndef ONELOOP_ANDI_SIMPLE_QUAD
2194 case COMMAND_MOTOR_PUSHER:
2195 case COMMAND_RUDDER:

2197 WLS_one_p.u_max[i] = (act_max[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2198 WLS_one_p.u_pref[i] = (u_pref[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2199 break;
2200 case COMMAND_AILERONS:
2201 if (RW.skew.deg > 25.0)
2202 {
2203 WLS_one_p.u_min[i] = (act_min[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2204 WLS_one_p.u_max[i] = (act_max[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2205 }
2206 else
2207 {
2208 WLS_one_p.u_min[i] = (0.0) / ratio_u_un[i];
2209 WLS_one_p.u_max[i] = (0.0) / ratio_u_un[i];
2210 }
2211 WLS_one_p.u_pref[i] = (u_pref[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2212 break;
2213 case COMMAND_FLAPS:
2214 if (RW.skew.deg > 50.0)
2215 {
2216 WLS_one_p.u_min[i] = (act_min[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2217 WLS_one_p.u_max[i] = (act_max[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2218 }
2219 else
2220 {
2221 WLS_one_p.u_min[i] = (0.0) / ratio_u_un[i];
2222 WLS_one_p.u_max[i] = (0.0) / ratio_u_un[i];
2223 }
2224 WLS_one_p.u_pref[i] = (u_pref[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2225 break;
2226 case COMMAND_ELEVATOR:
2227 WLS_one_p.u_min[i] = (act_min[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2228 WLS_one_p.u_max[i] = (act_max[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2229 u_pref[i] = RW.ele_pref;
2230 WLS_one_p.u_pref[i] = (u_pref[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2231 break;
2232#endif
2233 case COMMAND_ROLL:
2234 WLS_one_p.u_min[i] = (act_min[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2235 WLS_one_p.u_max[i] = (act_max[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2236 WLS_one_p.u_pref[i] = (u_pref[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2237 break;
2238 case COMMAND_PITCH:
2239#ifndef ONELOOP_ANDI_SIMPLE_QUAD
2240 if (RW.skew.deg > 50.0)
2241 {
2242#else
2243 if (false)
2244 {
2245#endif
2246 WLS_one_p.u_min[i] = (RadOfDeg(-17.0)) / ratio_u_un[i];
2247 WLS_one_p.u_max[i] = (RadOfDeg(17.0)) / ratio_u_un[i];
2248 }
2249 else
2250 {
2251 WLS_one_p.u_min[i] = (act_min[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2252 WLS_one_p.u_max[i] = (act_max[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2253 }
2254 WLS_one_p.u_pref[i] = (u_pref[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
2255 break;
2256 }
2257 }
2258 //printf("Pre alloc [phi_des,theta_des]=[%f,%f] \n",DegOfRad(eulers_zxy_des.phi),DegOfRad(eulers_zxy_des.theta));
2259 // WLS Control Allocator
2260 normalize_nu();
2261 wls_alloc(&WLS_one_p, bwls_1l, 0, 0, 10);
2262
2263 // Keep the previous command while a doublet runs (only when the sys_id_doublet module is loaded)
2264#ifdef MODULE_SYS_ID_DOUBLET_ID
2265 bool doublet_running = sys_id_doublet_running();
2266#else
2267 bool doublet_running = false;
2268#endif
2269 if (!doublet_running)
2270 {
2271 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
2272 {
2273 andi_u_n[i] = WLS_one_p.u[i];
2274 andi_u[i] = (float)(andi_u_n[i] * ratio_u_un[i]);
2275 }
2276 }
2277 else
2278 {
2279 reinit_controller();
2280 }
2281#ifdef COMMAND_MOTOR_PUSHER
2282 if ((half_loop))
2283 {
2284 andi_u[COMMAND_MOTOR_PUSHER] = radio_control.values[RADIO_AUX4];
2285 }
2286#endif
2287 // Run the dynamics substitution filter
2288 dynFilter_run(&mu_mR, andi_u[COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT], oneloop_andi_sigma);
2289 dynFilter_run(&mu_mL, andi_u[COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT], oneloop_andi_sigma);
2290 if (use_dyn_filter)
2291 {
2292 andi_u[COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT] = mu_mR.mu_c;
2293 andi_u[COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT] = mu_mL.mu_c;
2294 }
2295 // TODO : USE THE PROVIDED MAX AND MIN and change limits for phi and theta
2296 // Bound the inputs to the actuators
2297 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
2298 {
2299 Bound(andi_u[i], act_min[i], act_max[i]);
2300 }
2301 /*Commit the actuator command*/
2302 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT; i++)
2303 {
2304 commands[i] = (int16_t)andi_u[i];
2305 }
2306#ifndef ONELOOP_ANDI_SIMPLE_QUAD
2307 if (rotwing_state.fail_pusher_motor)
2308 {
2309 commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_PUSHER] = -9600; // Min(1000,andi_u[COMMAND_MOTOR_PUSHER]);
2310 }
2311#endif
2312 // if (manual_all){
2313 // for(i=0; i<4; i++){
2314 // if (i==chirp_axis){
2315 // commands[i] = radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE);
2316 // }
2317 // commands[i] = 0.0;
2318 // }
2319 //&& radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE)>200
2320 // commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT] = 0.0;//radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE);
2321 // commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT] = 0.0;//radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE);
2322 // commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT] = 0.0;//radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE);
2323 // commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK] = 0.0;//radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE);
2324 // }
2325 commands[COMMAND_THRUST] = (commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT] + commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT] + commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK] + commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT]) / num_thrusters_oneloop;
2326 autopilot.throttle = commands[COMMAND_THRUST];
2327 stabilization.cmd[COMMAND_THRUST] = commands[COMMAND_THRUST];
2328#ifndef USE_PID_OUTERLOOP
2329 if (!half_loop)
2330 {
2331 eulers_zxy_des.phi = andi_u[COMMAND_ROLL];
2332 eulers_zxy_des.theta = andi_u[COMMAND_PITCH];
2333 }
2334#endif
2335
2336 if (heading_manual)
2337 {
2338 psi_des_deg = DegOfRad(psi_des_rad);
2339 }
2340
2341 stabilization.cmd[COMMAND_ROLL] = (int16_t)(DegOfRad(eulers_zxy_des.phi) * MAX_PPRZ / DegOfRad(ONELOOP_ANDI_MAX_PHI));
2342 stabilization.cmd[COMMAND_PITCH] = (int16_t)(DegOfRad(eulers_zxy_des.theta) * MAX_PPRZ / DegOfRad(ONELOOP_ANDI_MAX_THETA));
2343 stabilization.cmd[COMMAND_YAW] = (int16_t)(psi_des_deg * MAX_PPRZ / 180.0);

2371#ifdef ONELOOP_ANDI_CONSTANT_EFFECTIVENESS
2377static void oneloop_andi_constant_eff(void)
2378{
2379 static const float g1_thrust[ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT] = ONELOOP_ANDI_G1_THRUST;
2380 static const float g1_roll[ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT] = ONELOOP_ANDI_G1_ROLL;
2381 static const float g1_pitch[ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT] = ONELOOP_ANDI_G1_PITCH;
2382 static const float g1_yaw[ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT] = ONELOOP_ANDI_G1_YAW;
2383 static const float g2[ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT] = ONELOOP_ANDI_G2;
2384 struct FloatEulers *eul = stateGetNedToBodyEulersZxy_f();
2385 float sphi = sinf(eul->phi), cphi = cosf(eul->phi);
2386 float stheta = sinf(eul->theta), ctheta = cosf(eul->theta);
2387 float spsi = sinf(eul->psi), cpsi = cosf(eul->psi);
2388 float T = 9.81f; // hover thrust specific force
2389 int i;
2390 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT; i++) {
2391 float gz = g1_thrust[i] / ANDI_G_SCALING;
2392 G2_RW[i] = g2[i] / ANDI_G_SCALING;
2393 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aN][i] = (cpsi * stheta + ctheta * sphi * spsi) * gz;
2394 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aE][i] = (spsi * stheta - cpsi * ctheta * sphi) * gz;
2395 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aD][i] = (cphi * ctheta) * gz;
2396 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_ap][i] = g1_roll[i] / ANDI_G_SCALING;
2397 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aq][i] = g1_pitch[i] / ANDI_G_SCALING;
2398 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_ar][i] = g1_yaw[i] / ANDI_G_SCALING + G2_RW[i];
2399 }
2400 for (i = ANDI_NUM_ACT; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++) {
2401 G2_RW[i] = 0.0f;
2402 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_ap][i] = 0.0f;
2403 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aq][i] = 0.0f;
2404 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_ar][i] = 0.0f;
2405 }
2406 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aN][COMMAND_ROLL] = -cphi * ctheta * spsi * T;
2407 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aE][COMMAND_ROLL] = cphi * ctheta * cpsi * T;
2408 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aD][COMMAND_ROLL] = sphi * ctheta * T;
2409 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aN][COMMAND_PITCH] = -(ctheta * cpsi - sphi * stheta * spsi) * T;
2410 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aE][COMMAND_PITCH] = -(ctheta * spsi + sphi * stheta * cpsi) * T;
2411 EFF_MAT_RW[RW_aD][COMMAND_PITCH] = stheta * cphi * T;
2412}
2413#endif
2414
2419void G1G2_oneloop(int ctrl_type)
2420{
2421 int i = 0;
2422 float scaler = 1.0;
2423#ifdef ONELOOP_ANDI_CONSTANT_EFFECTIVENESS
2424 oneloop_andi_constant_eff();
2425#endif
2426 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
2427 {
2428 // printf("act_dyn_ctrl[%d] = %f\n", i, act_dyn_ctrl[i]);
2429 switch (i)
2430 {
2431 case (COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT):
2432 case (COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT):
2433 case (COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK):
2434 case (COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT):
2435#ifndef ONELOOP_ANDI_SIMPLE_QUAD
2436 case (COMMAND_MOTOR_PUSHER):
2437 case (COMMAND_ELEVATOR):
2438 case (COMMAND_RUDDER):
2439 case (COMMAND_AILERONS):
2440 case (COMMAND_FLAPS):
2441#endif
2442 if (ctrl_type == CTRL_ANDI)
2443 {
2444 scaler = act_dyn_ctrl[i] * ratio_u_un[i];
2445 }
2446 else if (ctrl_type == CTRL_INDI)
2447 {
2448 scaler = ratio_u_un[i];
2449 }
2450 break;
2451 case (COMMAND_ROLL):
2452 case (COMMAND_PITCH):
2453 if (ctrl_type == CTRL_ANDI)
2454 {
2455 scaler = act_dyn_ctrl[i] * ratio_u_un[i];
2456 }
2457 else if (ctrl_type == CTRL_INDI)
2458 {
2459 scaler = ratio_u_un[i];
2460 }
2461 break;
2462 default:
2463 break;
2464 }
2465 int j = 0;
2466#ifndef ONELOOP_ANDI_SIMPLE_QUAD
2467 bool turn_quad_off = ((!rotwing_state.hover_motors_enabled || !rotwing_state_hover_motors_running()) && rotwing_state.state != ROTWING_STATE_FORCE_HOVER);
2468#else
2469 bool turn_quad_off = false;
2470#endif
2471 for (j = 0; j < ANDI_OUTPUTS; j++)
2472 {
2473 EFF_MAT_G[j][i] = EFF_MAT_RW[j][i] * scaler * ratio_vn_v[j];
2474 if (drop_yaw)
2475 {
2476 EFF_MAT_G[5][i] = 0.0;
2477 }
2478#ifndef ONELOOP_ANDI_SIMPLE_QUAD
2479 if (airspeed_filt.o[0] < ELE_MIN_AS && i == COMMAND_ELEVATOR)
2480 {
2481 EFF_MAT_G[j][i] = 0.0;
2482 }
2483#endif
2484 if (turn_quad_off && i < 4)
2485 {
2486 EFF_MAT_G[j][i] = 0.0;
2487 }
2488 if (ctrl_off && i < 4 && j == 5)
2489 { // hack test
2490 EFF_MAT_G[j][i] = 0.0;
2491 }
2492 if (ctrl_off && i < 4 && j == 4)
2493 { // hack test
2494 EFF_MAT_G[j][i] = 0.0;
2495 }
2496 if (ctrl_off && i < 4 && j == 3)
2497 { // hack test
2498 EFF_MAT_G[j][i] = 0.0;
2499 }
2500 // if (j < 2 && i < 4){
2501 // EFF_MAT_G[j][i] = 0.0;
2502 // }
2503 }
2504 }
2505 oneloop_axis_effectiveness_calc();
2506}

2509void calc_normalization(void)
2510{
2511 int8_t i;
2512 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
2513 {
2514 act_dynamics_d[i] = 1.0 - exp(-act_dynamics[i] * dt_1l);
2515 Bound(act_dynamics_d[i], 0.00001, 1.0);
2516 Bound(act_max[i], 0, MAX_PPRZ);
2517 Bound(act_min[i], -MAX_PPRZ, 0);
2518 float ratio_numerator = act_max[i] - act_min[i];
2519 ratio_numerator = positive_non_zero(ratio_numerator); // make sure numerator is non-zero
2520 float ratio_denominator = act_max_norm[i] - act_min_norm[i];
2521 ratio_denominator = positive_non_zero(ratio_denominator); // make sure denominator is non-zero
2522 ratio_u_un[i] = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
2523 ratio_u_un[i] = positive_non_zero(ratio_u_un[i]); // make sure ratio is not zero
2524 // printf("ratio_u_un[%d]= %f \n",i,ratio_u_un[i]);
2525 }
2526 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
2527 {
2528 float ratio_numerator = positive_non_zero(nu_norm_max);
2529 float ratio_denominator = 1.0;
2530 switch (i)
2531 {
2532 case (RW_aN):
2533 case (RW_aE):
2534 case (RW_aD):
2535 ratio_denominator = positive_non_zero(max_j_lin);
2536 ratio_vn_v[i] = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
2537 break;
2538 case (RW_ap):
2539 ratio_denominator = positive_non_zero(sta_bounds.att_3d[0]);
2540 ratio_vn_v[i] = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
2541 break;
2542 case (RW_aq):
2543 ratio_denominator = positive_non_zero(sta_bounds.att_3d[1]);
2544 ratio_vn_v[i] = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
2545 break;
2546 case (RW_ar):
2547 ratio_denominator = positive_non_zero(sta_bounds.att_3d[2]);
2548 ratio_vn_v[i] = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
2549 break;
2550 }
2551 }
2552}
2553
2555void normalize_nu(void)
2556{
2557 int8_t i;
2558 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
2559 {
2560 // printf("ratio_vn_v[%d] = %f \n",i,ratio_vn_v[i]);
2561 nu_n[i] = nu[i] * ratio_vn_v[i];
2562 WLS_one_p.v[i] = nu_n[i];
2563 }
2564}

2568void oneloop_from_nav(bool in_flight)
2569{
2570 if (!in_flight)
2571 {
2572 oneloop_andi_enter(false, oneloop_andi.ctrl_type);
2573 }
2574 struct FloatVect3 PSA_des;
2575 PSA_des.x = stateGetPositionNed_f()->x;
2576 PSA_des.y = stateGetPositionNed_f()->y;
2577 PSA_des.z = stateGetPositionNed_f()->z;
2578 int rm_order_h = 3;
2579 int rm_order_v = 3;
2580 // Oneloop controller wants desired targets and handles reference generation internally
2581 switch (nav.setpoint_mode)
2582 {
2583 case NAV_SETPOINT_MODE_POS:
2584 PSA_des.x = POS_FLOAT_OF_BFP(POS_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.target.y));
2585 PSA_des.y = POS_FLOAT_OF_BFP(POS_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.target.x));
2586 rm_order_h = 3;
2587 break;
2588 case NAV_SETPOINT_MODE_SPEED:
2589 PSA_des.x = SPEED_FLOAT_OF_BFP(SPEED_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.speed.y));
2590 PSA_des.y = SPEED_FLOAT_OF_BFP(SPEED_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.speed.x));
2591 rm_order_h = 2;
2592 break;
2593 }
2594 switch (nav.vertical_mode)
2595 {
2596 case NAV_VERTICAL_MODE_ALT:
2597 PSA_des.z = POS_FLOAT_OF_BFP(-POS_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.nav_altitude));
2598 rm_order_v = 3;
2599 break;
2600 case NAV_VERTICAL_MODE_CLIMB:
2601 PSA_des.z = SPEED_FLOAT_OF_BFP(-SPEED_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.climb));
2602 rm_order_v = 2;
2603 break;
2604 }
2605 oneloop_andi_run(in_flight, false, PSA_des, rm_order_h, rm_order_v);
2606}

2609float oneloop_andi_sideslip(void)
2610{
2611 // printf("Calculating the sideslip correction\n");
2612 // Coordinated turn
2613 // feedforward estimate angular rotation omega = g*tan(phi)/v
2614 float omega = 0.0;
2615 const float max_phi = ONELOOP_ANDI_MAX_BANK; // RadOfDeg(ONELOOP_ANDI_MAX_BANK);
2616 float airspeed_turn = airspeed_filt.o[0];
2617 Bound(airspeed_turn, 1.0f, 30.0f);
2618 // Use the current roll angle to determine the corresponding heading rate of change.
2619 float coordinated_turn_roll = eulers_zxy.phi;
2620 // Prevent flipping
2621 if ((eulers_zxy.theta > 0.0f) && (fabs(eulers_zxy.phi) < eulers_zxy.theta))
2622 {
2623 // printf("Preventing flipping\n");
2624 coordinated_turn_roll = ((eulers_zxy.phi > 0.0f) - (eulers_zxy.phi < 0.0f)) * eulers_zxy.theta;
2625 }
2626 BoundAbs(coordinated_turn_roll, max_phi);
2627 omega = g / airspeed_turn * tanf(coordinated_turn_roll);
2628// printf("Omega: %f\n", omega);
2629// printf("Coordinated turn roll: %f\n", DegOfRad(coordinated_turn_roll));
2630// printf("phi: %f\n", DegOfRad(eulers_zxy.phi));
2631// printf("Airspeed: %f\n", airspeed_turn);
2632#ifdef FWD_SIDESLIP_GAIN
2633 // Add sideslip correction
2634 omega -= accely_filt.o[0] * fwd_sideslip_gain;
2635// printf("Omega ay: %f\n", omega);
2636#endif
2637 return omega;
2638}
2639
2641static float chirp_pos_p_ref(float delta_t, float f0, float k, float A)
2642{
2643 float p_ref_fun = sinf(delta_t * M_PI * (f0 + k * delta_t) * 2.0);
2644 return (A * p_ref_fun);
2645}
2647static float chirp_pos_v_ref(float delta_t, float f0, float k, float A)
2648{
2649 float v_ref_fun = cosf(delta_t * M_PI * (f0 + k * delta_t) * 2.0) * (M_PI * (f0 + k * delta_t) * 2.0 + k * delta_t * M_PI * 2.0);
2650 return (A * v_ref_fun);
2651}
2653static float chirp_pos_a_ref(float delta_t, float f0, float k, float A)
2654{
2655 float a_ref_fun = -sinf(delta_t * M_PI * (f0 + k * delta_t) * 2.0) * pow((M_PI * (f0 + k * delta_t) * 2.0 + k * delta_t * M_PI * 2.0), 2) + k * M_PI * cosf(delta_t * M_PI * (f0 + k * delta_t) * 2.0) * 4.0;
2656 return (A * a_ref_fun);
2657}
2659static float chirp_pos_j_ref(float delta_t, float f0, float k, float A)
2660{
2661 float j_ref_fun = -cosf(delta_t * M_PI * (f0 + k * delta_t) * 2.0) * pow((M_PI * (f0 + k * delta_t) * 2.0 + k * delta_t * M_PI * 2.0), 3) - k * M_PI * sinf(delta_t * M_PI * (f0 + k * delta_t) * 2.0) * (M_PI * (f0 + k * delta_t) * 2.0 + k * delta_t * M_PI * 2.0) * 1.2e+1;
2662 return (A * j_ref_fun);
2663}
2664
2676void chirp_pos(float time_elapsed, float f0, float f1, float t_chirp, float A, int8_t n, float psi, float p_ref[], float v_ref[], float a_ref[], float j_ref[], float p_ref_0[])
2677{
2678 float A_backup = A;
2679 f0 = positive_non_zero(f0);
2680 f1 = positive_non_zero(f1);
2681 t_chirp = positive_non_zero(t_chirp);
2682 A = positive_non_zero(A);
2683 if ((f1 - f0) < -FLT_EPSILON)
2684 {
2685 f1 = f0;
2686 }
2687 // 0 body x, 1 body y, 2 body z, 3 pitch pref, 4 Yaw
2688 if (n > 6)
2689 {
2690 n = 0;
2691 }
2692 if (n < 0)
2693 {
2694 n = 0;
2695 }
2696 // I think there should not be a problem with f1 being equal to f0
2697 float k = (f1 - f0) / t_chirp;
2698 float p_ref_chirp = chirp_pos_p_ref(time_elapsed, f0, k, A);
2699 float v_ref_chirp = chirp_pos_v_ref(time_elapsed, f0, k, A);
2700 float a_ref_chirp = chirp_pos_a_ref(time_elapsed, f0, k, A);
2701 float j_ref_chirp = chirp_pos_j_ref(time_elapsed, f0, k, A);
2702
2703 float spsi = sinf(psi);
2704 float cpsi = cosf(psi);
2705 float mult_0 = 0.0;
2706 float mult_1 = 0.0;
2707 float mult_2 = 0.0;
2708 switch (n)
2709 {
2710 case 0:
2711 mult_0 = cpsi;
2712 mult_1 = spsi;
2713 mult_2 = 0.0;
2714
2715 p_ref[0] = p_ref_0[0] + p_ref_chirp * mult_0;
2716 p_ref[1] = p_ref_0[1] + p_ref_chirp * mult_1;
2717 v_ref[0] = v_ref_chirp * mult_0;
2718 v_ref[1] = v_ref_chirp * mult_1;
2719 a_ref[0] = a_ref_chirp * mult_0;
2720 a_ref[1] = a_ref_chirp * mult_1;
2721 j_ref[0] = j_ref_chirp * mult_0;
2722 j_ref[1] = j_ref_chirp * mult_1;
2723 break;
2724 case 1:
2725 mult_0 = -spsi;
2726 mult_1 = cpsi;
2727 mult_2 = 0.0;
2728
2729 p_ref[0] = p_ref_0[0] + p_ref_chirp * mult_0;
2730 p_ref[1] = p_ref_0[1] + p_ref_chirp * mult_1;
2731 v_ref[0] = v_ref_chirp * mult_0;
2732 v_ref[1] = v_ref_chirp * mult_1;
2733 a_ref[0] = a_ref_chirp * mult_0;
2734 a_ref[1] = a_ref_chirp * mult_1;
2735 j_ref[0] = j_ref_chirp * mult_0;
2736 j_ref[1] = j_ref_chirp * mult_1;
2737 break;
2738 case 2:
2739 mult_0 = 0.0;
2740 mult_1 = 0.0;
2741 mult_2 = 1.0;
2742 p_ref[2] = p_ref_0[2] + p_ref_chirp * mult_2;
2743 v_ref[2] = v_ref_chirp * mult_2;
2744 a_ref[2] = a_ref_chirp * mult_2;
2745 j_ref[2] = j_ref_chirp * mult_2;
2746 break;
2747 case 3:
2748 // Pitch preferred chirp
2749 pitch_pref = p_ref_chirp;
2750 pitch_pref = (pitch_pref / A + 1.0) * (theta_pref_max / 2.0);
2751 float pitch_offset = RadOfDeg(5.0);
2752 pitch_pref = pitch_pref + pitch_offset;
2753 Bound(pitch_pref, 0.0, 25.0);
2754 break;
2755 case 4:
2756 // Do a yaw acceleration chirp
2757 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att[2] = psi_des_rad + p_ref_chirp * M_PI / 180.0; // oneloop_andi.sta_state.att[2];
2758 NormRadAngle(oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att[2]);
2759 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_d[2] = v_ref_chirp * M_PI / 180.0; // oneloop_andi.sta_state.att_d[2];
2760 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d[2] = a_ref_chirp * M_PI / 180.0; // p_ref_chirp;
2761 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_3d[2] = j_ref_chirp * M_PI / 180.0; // v_ref_chirp;
2762 // Include change in dynamics
2763 oneloop_andi_sigma = (oneloop_andi_sigma_min - oneloop_andi_sigma_max) / t_chirp * time_elapsed + oneloop_andi_sigma_max;
2764 Bound(oneloop_andi_sigma, oneloop_andi_sigma_min, oneloop_andi_sigma_max);
2765 break;
2766 case 5:
2767 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att[2] = oneloop_andi.sta_state.att[2];
2768 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_d[2] = oneloop_andi.sta_state.att_d[2];
2769 if (time_elapsed < (t_chirp / 4.0) || (time_elapsed > (3.0 * t_chirp / 4.0)))
2770 {
2771 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d[2] = 0.0;
2772 }
2773 else
2774 {
2775 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d[2] = A_backup * M_PI / 180.0;
2776 }
2777 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_3d[2] = 0.0;
2778 float S_psi = 0.5 * A_backup * M_PI / 180.0 * t_chirp * t_chirp;
2779 BoundAbs(S_psi, 0.9 * M_PI_2)
2780 psi_des_rad = oneloop_andi.sta_state.att[2] + S_psi;
2781 NormRadAngle(psi_des_rad);
2782 // Set the EC to track a 0 acceleration in Z
2783 p_ref[2] = oneloop_andi.gui_state.pos[2];
2784 v_ref[2] = oneloop_andi.gui_state.vel[2];
2785 a_ref[2] = 0.0;
2786 drop_aN = true;
2787 drop_aE = true;
2788
2789 break;
2790 case 6:
2791 // Do a doublet on the roll acceleration
2792 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att[0] = oneloop_andi.sta_state.att[0];
2793 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_d[0] = oneloop_andi.sta_state.att_d[0];
2794 // oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d[0] = (time_elapsed < (t_chirp/2.0)) ? A*M_PI/180.0 : -A*M_PI/180.0;
2795 if (time_elapsed < (0.5))
2796 {
2797 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d[0] = 0.0;
2798 }
2799 else
2800 {
2801 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_2d[0] = -A * M_PI / 180.0;
2802 }
2803 oneloop_andi.sta_ref.att_3d[0] = 0.0;
2804 drop_aN = true;
2805 drop_aE = true;
2806 break;
2807 }
2808}

2810void chirp_call(bool *chirp_on, bool *chirp_first_call, float *t_0, float *time_elapsed, float f0, float f1, float t_chirp, float A, int8_t n, float psi, float p_ref[], float v_ref[], float a_ref[], float j_ref[], float p_ref_0[])
2811{
2812 if (*chirp_on)
2813 {
2814 if (*chirp_first_call)
2815 {
2816 *time_elapsed = 0.0;
2817 *chirp_first_call = false;
2818 *t_0 = get_sys_time_float();
2819 p_ref_0[0] = p_ref[0];
2820 p_ref_0[1] = p_ref[1];
2821 p_ref_0[2] = p_ref[2];
2822 }
2823 if (*time_elapsed < t_chirp)
2824 {
2825 *time_elapsed = get_sys_time_float() - *t_0;
2826 chirp_pos(*time_elapsed, f0, f1, t_chirp, A, n, psi, p_ref, v_ref, a_ref, j_ref, p_ref_0);
2827 }
2828 else
2829 {
2830 *chirp_on = false;
2831 *chirp_first_call = true;
2832 *time_elapsed = 0.0;
2833 *t_0 = 0.0;
2834 p_ref_0[0] = p_ref[0];
2835 p_ref_0[1] = p_ref[1];
2836 p_ref_0[2] = p_ref[2];
2837 float_vect_zero(v_ref, 3);
2838 float_vect_zero(a_ref, 3);
2839 float_vect_zero(j_ref, 3);
2840 drop_yaw = false;
2841 drop_roll = false;
2842 drop_pitch = false;
2843 drop_aN = false;
2844 drop_aE = false;
2845 drop_aD = false;
2846 // oneloop_andi_enter(false, oneloop_andi.ctrl_type);
2847 }
2848 }

2857void reshape_wind(void)
2858{
2859 float psi = eulers_zxy.psi;
2860 float cpsi = cosf(psi);
2861 float spsi = sinf(psi);
2862 float airspeed = airspeed_filt.o[0];
2863 struct FloatVect2 NT_v_NE = {nav_target[0], nav_target[1]}; // Nav target in North and East frame
2864 struct FloatVect2 airspeed_v = {cpsi * airspeed, spsi * airspeed};
2865 struct FloatVect2 windspeed;
2866 struct FloatVect2 groundspeed = {oneloop_andi.gui_state.vel[0], oneloop_andi.gui_state.vel[1]};
2867 struct FloatVect2 des_as_NE;
2868 struct FloatVect2 des_as_B;
2869 struct FloatVect2 des_acc_B;
2870 VECT2_DIFF(windspeed, groundspeed, airspeed_v); // Wind speed in North and East frame
2871 VECT2_DIFF(des_as_NE, NT_v_NE, windspeed); // Desired airspeed in North and East frame
2872 float norm_des_as = FLOAT_VECT2_NORM(des_as_NE);
2873 gi_unbounded_airspeed_sp = norm_des_as;
2874 // Check if some minimum airspeed is desired (e.g. to prevent stall)
2875 if (norm_des_as < min_as)
2876 {
2877 norm_des_as = min_as;
2878 }
2879 nav_target_new[0] = NT_v_NE.x;
2880 nav_target_new[1] = NT_v_NE.y;
2881 // if the desired airspeed is larger than the max airspeed or we are in force forward reshape gs des to cancel wind and fly at max airspeed
2882 if ((norm_des_as > max_as) || (force_forward))
2883 {
2884 float groundspeed_factor = 0.0f;
2885 if (FLOAT_VECT2_NORM(windspeed) < max_as)
2886 {
2887 float av = NT_v_NE.x * NT_v_NE.x + NT_v_NE.y * NT_v_NE.y; // norm squared of nav target
2888 float bv = -2.f * (windspeed.x * NT_v_NE.x + windspeed.y * NT_v_NE.y);
2889 float cv = windspeed.x * windspeed.x + windspeed.y * windspeed.y - max_as * max_as;
2890 float dv = bv * bv - 4.0f * av * cv;
2891 // dv can only be positive, but just in case
2892 if (dv < 0.0f)
2893 {
2894 dv = fabsf(dv);
2895 }
2896 float d_sqrt = sqrtf(dv);
2897 groundspeed_factor = (-bv + d_sqrt) / (2.0f * av);
2898 }
2899 des_as_NE.x = groundspeed_factor * NT_v_NE.x - windspeed.x;
2900 des_as_NE.y = groundspeed_factor * NT_v_NE.y - windspeed.y;
2901 NT_v_NE.x = groundspeed_factor * NT_v_NE.x;
2902 NT_v_NE.y = groundspeed_factor * NT_v_NE.y;
2903 norm_des_as = max_as;
2904 }
2905 des_as_B.x = norm_des_as; // Desired airspeed in body x frame
2906 des_as_B.y = 0.0; // Desired airspeed in body y frame
2907 if (((airspeed > ONELOOP_ANDI_AIRSPEED_SWITCH_THRESHOLD) && (norm_des_as > (ONELOOP_ANDI_AIRSPEED_SWITCH_THRESHOLD + 2.0f))) || (force_forward))
2908 {
2909 float delta_psi = atan2f(des_as_NE.y, des_as_NE.x) - psi;
2910 FLOAT_ANGLE_NORMALIZE(delta_psi);
2911 des_acc_B.y = delta_psi * 5.0; // gih_params.heading_bank_gain;
2912 des_acc_B.x = (des_as_B.x - airspeed) * k_pos_rm.k2[0]; // gih_params.speed_gain;
2913 acc_body_bound(&des_acc_B, max_a_nav); // Scale down side acceleration if norm is too large
2914 nav_target_new[0] = cpsi * des_acc_B.x - spsi * des_acc_B.y;
2915 nav_target_new[1] = spsi * des_acc_B.x + cpsi * des_acc_B.y;
2916 }
2917 else
2918 {
2919 nav_target_new[0] = (NT_v_NE.x - groundspeed.x) * k_pos_rm.k2[0];
2920 nav_target_new[1] = (NT_v_NE.y - groundspeed.y) * k_pos_rm.k2[1];
2921 }
2922 vect_bound_nd(nav_target_new, max_a_nav, 2);
2923}

2931void oneloop_axis_effectiveness_calc(void)
2932{
2933 // Reset the effectiveness matrix
2934 memset(n_array, 0, sizeof(n_array));
2935 memset(coupling_factor, 0, sizeof(coupling_factor));
2936 memset(m_array, 0, sizeof(m_array));
2937 float u_trim[ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT];
2938 u_trim[COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT] = 4800.0;
2939 u_trim[COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT] = 4800.0;
2940 u_trim[COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK] = 4800.0;
2941 u_trim[COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT] = 4800.0;
2942#ifndef ONELOOP_ANDI_SIMPLE_QUAD
2943 u_trim[COMMAND_MOTOR_PUSHER] = 0.0;
2944 u_trim[COMMAND_ELEVATOR] = RW.ele_pref;
2945 u_trim[COMMAND_RUDDER] = 0.0;
2946 u_trim[COMMAND_AILERONS] = 0.0;
2947 u_trim[COMMAND_FLAPS] = 0.0;
2948#endif
2949 u_trim[COMMAND_ROLL] = 0.0;
2950 u_trim[COMMAND_PITCH] = 0.0;
2951
2952 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
2953 {
2954 for (int j = 0; j < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; j++)
2955 {
2956 float eff = positive_non_zero(fabsf(EFF_MAT_G[i][j]));
2957 float den = positive_non_zero(ratio_u_un[j] * ratio_vn_v[i]);
2958 float u_range = MAX_PPRZ - u_trim[j];
2959 eff = (eff / den) * u_range;
2960 n_array[i] += eff;
2961 m_array[j] += eff;
2962 }
2963 }
2964 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
2965 {
2966 for (int j = 0; j < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; j++)
2967 {
2968 float eff = positive_non_zero(fabsf(EFF_MAT_G[i][j]));
2969 float den = positive_non_zero(ratio_u_un[j] * ratio_vn_v[i]);
2970 float u_range = MAX_PPRZ - u_trim[j];
2971 eff = (eff / den) * u_range;
2972 float eff2 = eff * eff;
2973 coupling_factor[i] += eff2 / (n_array[i] * m_array[j]);
2974 }
2975 }
2976 Bound(coupling_factor[5], 0.2, 0.8);
2977 // printf("Coupling factor: %f %f %f %f %f %f \n", coupling_factor[0], coupling_factor[1], coupling_factor[2], coupling_factor[3], coupling_factor[4], coupling_factor[5]);
2978 // printf("Axis effectiven: %f %f %f %f %f %f \n", n_array[0], n_array[1], n_array[2], n_array[3], n_array[4], n_array[5]);
2979}

2981void oneloop_calc_model_disturbance(bool in_flight)
2982{
2983 int8_t i;
2984 int8_t j;
2985 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
2986 {
2987 if (i < ANDI_NUM_ACT)
2988 {
2989 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&u_filt[i], actuator_state_1l[i]);
2990 }
2991 else
2992 {
2993 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&u_filt[i], oneloop_andi.sta_state.att[i - ANDI_NUM_ACT]);
2994 }
2995 }
2996 // Store the distrubance
2997 float k3;
2998 if (in_flight)
2999 {
3000 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
3001 { // For loop for prediction of acceleration
3002 oneloop_andi_model[i] = 0.0;
3003 switch (i)
3004 {
3005 case (RW_aN):
3006 k3 = 1.0; // k_pos_e.k3[0];
3007 break;
3008 case (RW_aE):
3009 k3 = 1.0; // k_pos_e.k3[1];
3010 break;
3011 case (RW_aD):
3012 k3 = 1.0; // k_pos_e.k3[2];
3013 break;
3014 case (RW_ap):
3015 k3 = k_att_e.k3[0];
3016 break;
3017 case (RW_aq):
3018 k3 = k_att_e.k3[1];
3019 break;
3020 case (RW_ar):
3021 k3 = k_att_e.k3[2];
3022 break;
3023 }
3024 k3 = positive_non_zero(k3);
3025 if (i == RW_aN)
3026 {
3027 // printf("start oneloop_andi_model : %f \n",oneloop_andi_model[i]);
3028 }
3029 for (j = 0; j < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; j++)
3030 {
3031 float den = positive_non_zero(ratio_u_un[j] * ratio_vn_v[i]);
3032 float num = u_filt[j].o[0] * EFF_MAT_G[i][j];
3033 oneloop_andi_model[i] += num / den;
3034 }
3035 oneloop_andi_model[i] = oneloop_andi_model[i] / k3;
3036 }
3037 update_filter_on_type(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.ax, oneloop_andi_model[RW_aN]);
3038 update_filter_on_type(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.ay, oneloop_andi_model[RW_aE]);
3039 update_filter_on_type(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.az, oneloop_andi_model[RW_aD]);
3040 update_filter_on_type(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.p_dot, oneloop_andi_model[RW_ap]);
3041 update_filter_on_type(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.q_dot, oneloop_andi_model[RW_aq]);
3042 update_filter_on_type(&oneloop_andi_model_filt.r_dot, oneloop_andi_model[RW_ar]);
3043 }
3044 else
3045 {
3046 float_vect_zero(oneloop_andi_model, ANDI_OUTPUTS);
3047 }
3048}
3049void oneloop_andi_bound_disturbance(void)
3050{
3051 oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_aN] = oneloop_andi.gui_state.acc[0] - oneloop_andi_model[RW_aN];
3052 BoundAbs(oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_aN], 99999.f); // Large value to not bound
3053 oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_aE] = oneloop_andi.gui_state.acc[1] - oneloop_andi_model[RW_aE];
3054 BoundAbs(oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_aE], 99999.f); // Large value to not bound
3055 oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_aD] = oneloop_andi.gui_state.acc[2] - oneloop_andi_model[RW_aD];
3056 BoundAbs(oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_aD], 99999.f); // Large value to not bound
3057 oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_ap] = oneloop_andi.sta_state.att_2d[0] - oneloop_andi_model[RW_ap];
3058 BoundAbs(oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_ap], 99999.f); // Large value to not bound
3059 oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_aq] = oneloop_andi.sta_state.att_2d[1] - oneloop_andi_model[RW_aq];
3060 BoundAbs(oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_aq], 99999.f); // Large value to not bound
3061 oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_ar] = oneloop_andi.sta_state.att_2d[2] - oneloop_andi_model[RW_ar];
3062 BoundAbs(oneloop_andi_dist_bound[RW_ar], 99999.f); // Large value to not bound

3077void dynFilter_run(struct Oneloop_DynFilt_t *mu, float u_c, float sigma)
3078{
3079 mu->mu_c_0 = mu->mu_c;
3080 mu->u_c_0 = mu->u_c;
3081 mu->u_c = u_c;
3082 mu->sigma = sigma;
3083
3084 // Calculate ZOH-based coefficients
3085 float exp_term = expf(-mu->sigma / mu->fs); // Use expf for float precision
3086 float c_u_c = mu->sigma / mu->varepsilon;
3087 float c_u_c_0 = (-mu->sigma + mu->varepsilon - mu->varepsilon * exp_term) / mu->varepsilon;
3088 float c_mu_c_0 = exp_term;
3089
3090 mu->mu_c = c_u_c * mu->u_c + c_u_c_0 * mu->u_c_0 + c_mu_c_0 * mu->mu_c_0;
3091}
